mapper.select: select sequence_no from mock_sap_schema.stream_clock where entity_type=#{type} for update
select sequence_no from mock_sap_schema.stream_clock where entity_type=#{type}
select source_version from mock_sap_schema.master_record where entity_type=#{type} and business_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: insert into mock_sap_schema.master_record(entity_type,business_key,source_version,record_json) values (#{type},#{key},#{version},#{json}) on conflict(entity_type,business_key) do update set source_version=excluded.source_version,record_json=excluded.record_json
mapper.update: update mock_sap_schema.stream_clock set sequence_no=#{sequence} where entity_type=#{type}
mapper.select: select count(*) from mock_sap_schema.master_record where entity_type=#{type}

mapper.insert: insert into mock_sap_schema.snapshot_item(snapshot_id,item_no,record_json) select #{id},row_number() over(order by business_key),record_json from mock_sap_schema.master_record where entity_type=#{type}
mapper.select: select id,baseline_cursor,record_count from mock_sap_schema.snapshot where id=#{id} and entity_type=#{type} and created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
